# ui::PrintPage

Header: `winui/ui/Printing.hpp`.

One page of a print job, as its callbacks get it. Sizes are DIPs, 1/96 inch, as on screen.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | `std::size_t` | `0` | 0-based, in the whole document (not just the pages being printed). |
| `size` | `Size` |  | The sheet, in the orientation the user chose. |
| `printable` | `Rect` |  | The part of the sheet the printer can reach, from its top-left. |
